evidence.title: Scene 29, 方壶胜境 Fanghu Shengjing
evidence.excerpt_other: On this terrace there were two large buildings and four smaller side buildings, all of two stories and with elevated walks connecting their second stories.
evidence.summary: Upper brick-faced terrace: two large and four smaller two-storey buildings linked at upper level. Lower terrace on the lake: three two-storey buildings. A bridge and two piers to three small terraces with open pavilions, marble balustrades and steps for the barge. Twelve buildings with golden glazed tile. Built 1740 (Tse Li vol. 2 p.33, vol. 20 p.8). Smaller palace to the east, another across the lake north, boathouse.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
